visual_antislop_standards.zero_em_dash_policy: Strict prohibition of em-dash and double-hyphens. Use brackets, pipes, colons, or middle dots.

typography_rules.case_convention: Sentence case or Upper Snake Case for telemetry keys; clean numeric for values
typography_rules.font_formatting: Strictly avoid obfuscated text, italic clutter, or excessive bolding

background_border.role: Frame boundaries and visual grouping separators

primary_brand.role: Server identity, section highlights, and major headers

telemetry_healthy.role: Optimal TPS (20.0), low ping (<50ms), secure status

telemetry_danger.role: Degraded TPS (<18.0), high ping (>120ms), security alerts

muted_label.role: Metric labels and static structural text

bright_value.role: Numeric data points, player names, and coordinates

animation_policy.allowed_animations: Subtle single-character telemetry pulse or stable monochromatic glow with interval >= 1000ms

telemetry_metrics_matrix.pedagogical_relevance: SRE observability baseline; teaches real-time hardware load monitoring
Demonstrates heap allocation and JVM garbage collection in action
Round-trip network latency awareness for responsive red-teaming execution
Heterogeneous system integration; highlights protocol bridging between Java and Bedrock
Spatial awareness and multi-instance containerization visualization
Vector mathematics and discrete 3D Cartesian coordinates
Gamified progress tracking for White Jack across vulnerability exploitation modules

bedrock_mobile_constraints.hud_safe_zone_margin: 10% margin padding to avoid touch D-pad and jump button obstruction
bedrock_mobile_constraints.floodgate_prefix_handling: Bedrock names start with dot prefix; allocate 17 characters for username fields
bedrock_mobile_constraints.legacy_formatting_fallback: Strict support for standard ampersand formatting codes to prevent raw hex leakage on Bedrock

performance_packet_budget.anti_lag_safeguard: Never poll database or asynchronous web endpoints on main server thread

dimensions.name: Cognitive Clarity

dimensions.criteria: Accurate representation of TPS, memory, latency, and operational health without stale caching

dimensions.name: Crossplay Parity
dimensions.criteria: Flawless rendering on both Java PC widescreen and Bedrock mobile 16:9 vertical/horizontal viewports
